## What problem does this solve?

Describe scope and user-visible behavior. Distinguish implemented changes from proposals.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` — include actual result, or explain why not run.
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` — include actual result, or state browser/network blocker.
- [ ] Relevant synthetic regression tests and docs updated.
- [ ] UI changes: keyboard, narrow viewport, dialog focus, and full exports checked, or explicitly marked unverified.

## Privacy and claims

- [ ] No actual histories, private code/prompts, paths, credentials, raw secret logs, or sensitive browser artifacts included. Fixtures are authored from scratch.
- [ ] No new trace upload, telemetry, execution of imported content, or unreviewed weakening of export boundaries.
- [ ] Cache-inclusive input, unknown metrics, and descriptive comparison semantics preserved.
- [ ] New adapters self-register through auto-discovery; no dispatcher branches.
- [ ] No fake passing badges, release/demo links, benchmark claims, or roadmap-as-implemented statements.

For vulnerabilities follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md); do not include exploit details here publicly.
